name: sms-translator
description: Windows desktop SMS inbox that mirrors an Android phone over ADB and translates/screens messages with Claude
author: Prime Anchor

scripts.dev:app: wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run build:electron && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.test: npm run build:electron && node test/parse-sms.js && node test/parse-mms.js && node test/send-button.js && node test/locate-adb.js && node test/wireless.js && node test/contacts.js && node test/store.js && node test/web-server.js && node test/upload.js && node test/output-config.js
